title: Create Physics Staff
description: This mod introduces a Remote Physics Staff that allows you to transform structures into fully physical contraptions from afar and seamlessly restore them back into blocks.
body:
This mod introduces a Remote Physics Staff that allows you to transform structures into fully physical contraptions from afar and seamlessly restore them back into blocks. It also adds a collection of decorative CAL Team plushies to brighten up your builds.

All custom models included in this mod were designed and created by my friend SekzaMC.
